ic_name: Single Edge Nibble Transmission (SENT, SAE J2716)
base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: SENT (SAE J2716) is a sensor transmission interface rather than a memory-mapped register IC. A SENT sensor has configuration parameters (tick time, number of data nibbles, channel format, pause-pulse enable, CRC variant, slow-channel content) that are fixed for a given sensor or programmed at manufacture; the ECU side exposes decoded values and status. The groups below are the canonical SENT configuration/status surfaces.

register_access.transport: Sensor configuration (often factory-programmed) + ECU decoded-value/status registers
register_access.purpose: Configure the frame format and decode the nibble stream.

fields: Pause-pulse enable and target frame length
Slow serial message buffer (ID / data / CRC)
